title: Gender-Dependent Diagnostic Substitution in LLM Medical Triage: Same Symptoms, Unequal Urgency

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing emergency room (ER) referral rates and differential diagnoses for identical neurological symptom profiles across male, female, and gender-unspecified patient personas.
Evaluating how triage recommendations and gender-based disparities are modulated across different patient age groups (25, 38, and 65 years old) to identify age-dependent diagnostic patterns.
